title: A Thought
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 1
visual_description: A vertical landscape of a large blue and light brown riverbank surrounded by a blue mountain rage in the far distance, and lush green pine trees. The sky is a deep blue and purple, and there are birds flying in the sky.

title: Smiling Faces
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall B
visual_description: A photorealistic pencil drawing of four people: three young children and a woman. They are all smiling as if posing for a picture.

title: Nature's "Killer" Cannonball
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 3
visual_description: A drawing of a large Orca leaping out of water and falling toward the right. There is a large splash from the tail of the Orca, and the geometricly curved waves are a dark blue color. There is a flock of seagulls in the orange and blue sunset.

title: Nature's Flights for Life #1
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 5
visual_description: A large brown owl swoops low to the ground with it's talons reached out to catch a thin,long, grey squirrel running away with an acorn in it's mouth. They are in an open clearing within an orange and green forest. The shadow on the ground beneath the owl and squirrel is a dark evergreen color.

title: Nature's Flights for Life #2
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall H
visual_description: A vertical landscape of a large bird of prey swooping down to a stump to catch a grey fox from behind. The background is a lush green river surrounded by light green grass and black lines of trees. There is a tall and pointy mountain range at the top of the drawing in the horizon, and a bright orange sun rising over the peaks.

title: Distinguish
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 3

title: True Ink
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall C
visual_description: A large light cartoonish green octopus with large yellow eyes is behind a woman in a black tight sleeveless bodysuit, she is covered in blood on her neck and tight, and smirks holding one hand on her large black sunhat. The background is fillled with yellow and pink polka dots, and a pink hearts with the number 6 in cursive dripping ink.

title: Boss Goddess
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall E
visual_description: A woman with large angel wings, sleeve of tattoos is wearing a tight black vest and sunglasses, and holding a microphone. In the background there are rows of roses, and music notes. The top of the page has cursvie letters that say,"boss godess."

title: Death Ink Reaper
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 5
visual_description: In a cemetary with a wooden cross and a skull, there is a large grim reaper with a scythe dripping with blood. The hood on cloak of the grim reaper has a moaning face, and faces down the side of the garment. The ghost like grim reaper is leaking and floating up from the inside of a canister at the bottom left of the page that says,"Death Ink"

title: When My Plastic Bag Grows Up
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall C
visual_description: A detailed black and white ink drawing of a man who is bald and has a beard, hanging with bloody knuckles. He stands beside lookind down at a smooth snowman like object with a cartoonish smiling face, there is a bloody mark on the durface of it's face. The background is in a large open space with a hill of grasses on the left edge of the page.

title: Purple Butterfly
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 1
visual_description: A woman is standing sidewars facing the right, with her face tilted down she is looking up, and one hand is on her long straight hair, the other pulling at a sleeveless tank top. She is wearing tight jeans, a braided belt, and has a tattoo of a pair of lips biting somthing.

title: Self Portrait: Mistake or Mosaic?
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall E
visual_description: A man's tan face with green eyes and a chin with stubble is surrounded by various colors, shapes and patterns: his head is covered in striaght thick paint stroles of neautral colors, and above that there are circles of varying sizes, that turn into octogons. Below the face, the neck tapers off into a bright yellow pattern of octagons, and green outlined squares and rectangles.

title: Fishing Man
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall D
visual_description: On a bright blue lake there is a brown pier with two people sitting and fishing, beside them there is a dog, radio, and two beverages. One person waves toward another pair of people that are fishing from a small boat on the water. In the background there is a mountain range and trees. Three Monarch butterflies fly around the pier.

title: Fairy Dust
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 2
visual_description: A dark grey slab has white engravings of a dainty fairy leaning over to touch a flower petal or a large blooming flower. Around her there are two large dragonflies, and large crescent shapes of white above her.

title: Serene
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 2

title: Eat Your Heart Out
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall I
visual_description: A woman with tan skin and short purple hair raises a hand that's holding an anatomical heart on a stick. Her other hand is raised to her face as she sucks on a skeleton finger and blood drops from her mouth. She has a small pink tank top on, and there is a bite mark on the left breast dripping blood. The background is pink and red, resembling dripping blood.

title: The Unseen Kingdom
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 6
visual_description: Two fairies sit on the top of leaves surrounded by giant purple flowers and green leaves. One fairy has bright green hair, and the other has long red hair, they are both wearing green serrated tank tops and skirts.

title: My Cabie
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall G
visual_description: A chest up drawing of a man with large muscles wearing a blue prison uniform with an orange strip over the shoulders. His arms are crossed over one another, and the right arm has a cursive letter tattoo, "Blessed." The head of the man is an insect head with large antennae, and small feelers on the face.

title: Tia Likes It
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 1
visual_description: A drawing of a woman with long straight hair, and a headdress of a rose and feathers coming off a headband with geometric designs. She is crying, her head is coming out of a skeleton jaw, that rests on top of a roman numeral clock. The center of the clock is the apex of a pyramid with an eye.

title: Ascending
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall C
visual_description: A mechanical woman body made from gears and hinges is swimming in a body of water, her body vertical. There are mechanical-esque schools of fish beside her and at her feet.

title: The Fall of Phaeton by Michelangelo 1533
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall F
visual_description: A renaissance style vertical drawing. At the top, there is a man emerging from a cloud holding a lightening bolt riding an eagle. In the center, there is a tipped cart of animals spilling out: four hourses and a man. At the bottom there are women, a man, and a child looking at the scene above them, cowering. The old man lays with his arm over a vessel leaking water turning into a stream.

title: The Brand
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 1

title: The Traveler
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall C
visual_description: The back of a person's shoulder blades the skin is peeled back to reveal a msucular system on the left that is red and white stripes, and the right is a series of screws and wires with white and blue accents.

title: LIBERTY-FREEDOM
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall G
visual_description: A sculpture of an elephant made of grey fabric, is tied and bound by blue cuts of fabric. Beside it is a red, white, and blue poster and small podium that resembles the flag of the United States. The poster reads an acronym for FREEDOM: falshood, restrained, erased, eliminated, divine, optimistic, mind.

title: Awake
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 5
visual_description: A line drawing of part of a face: a closed eye, mouth, and jawline. Beside the face there is a hand with an eye in the palm, the fingers are many different colors and shapes, and overlap with three other line drawings of the same hand. The background is a yellow sky with clouds that morphs into a blue and purple blend of color toward the right. Sweeping from the bottom right to top left there is a thick streak of blue, pink, and yellow color. At the bottom of the page there is a thick blue line that blends out at the bottom right.

title: The Nature of Things
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall I
visual_description: Negative shapes that are filled with different color letters create a landscape of green land, blue sky, and the purple sun. In the center there is a large orange thin wild cat-like animal standing sideways with it's tail stretched out.

title: They Found Me
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall D
visual_description: A wide open desert landscape with large rock structures in the far distance. There are a few tall cacti with two arms spread out. In the blue sjy there is a large yellow sun. There is a pink man or cactus with a face that is being attacked by a flock of black birds, a red line on the ground resembles internal organs. There is a flock of birds flying in the distant sky.

title: The Archetypal Light
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall A
visual_description: A detailed and horizontal drawing of mandala like pattern. There are large octogons surrounding a 8 pointed square-ish star. Inside of that there are smaller patterns surrounding a radial focal point.

title: Citrus Girl
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall D
visual_description: A crocheted or knit hat with a pom-pom, and a turtle neck shawl. There are rows of green, yellow, and orange, patterned with solid lines of yellow.

title: Sleep and Dream of Better Things
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall I
visual_description: A square painting of a landscape that is surrounded by a large square of repeating text that says, "Sleep and dream of better things..." The landscape is a bright yellow field with a path curing toward the horizon to the left. There is a bright yellow sun rising into a blue sky with wispy clouds.

title: Urban Reflections
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall I
visual_description: A grey and dreary city sidewalk and street scene: people walking with umbrellas, a cars lined up at a green light, and a train passing on a track over the street. There are a few small black trees.

title: America's Lighthouse
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall D
visual_description: There is a greyscale photorealistic drawing of a white brick lighthouse on the rocky sea shore. Beside it is a United States flag blowing in the breeze. There is also a leafless American Birch tree in the grass beside the shore.

title: Royal Slippers
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall H
visual_description: A pair of handmade slippers from yarn. The front of the slippers are pale yellow, the edge a brown, and the bottom black. The inside of the slippers are striped red and bright yellow.

title: I'm Different and Colorful
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 5
visual_description: A bird rests on a single bare branch. The bird has a bright red head with spiked crest, long orange beak and chest, and black and blue striped wings.

title: Blink of an Eye
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 1
visual_description: A drawing of a woman from the chest up. She rests her right hand on her left shoulder. She is wearing a dark sleeveless tank top. She is making a face : winking the right eye and biting the left corner of her mouth, stiking out the tongue just a bit. Her hair is straight anf short, combed over the left side of the face.

title: True Innocence
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall B
visual_description: A photorealistic drawing of an African American baby girl's head. She is smiling, showing two front baby teeth. Her hair is sectioned off into smaller braids, and from three braids there are three pink and yellow flower clips.

title: War Cry
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall A

title: Am I Still Pretty
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners
visual_description: A close up drawing of a person with long flowing hair and strands covering their face, they are wearing a mask over their nose, and red tears are falling from their eyes.

title: After a Visit
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall B
visual_description: A colorful drawing of two people holding eachother and smiling sitting on a bench. On the left there is a young girl wearing a blue tshirt that says, "love my dad," shorts and sandals. Holding her is an older man wearing a red shirt and blue shorts with tennis shoes. They both are wearing sunglasses. The background is a grassy area with flowers and a path leading to a large brick building with industrial doors.

title: Momma I'm Coming Home
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall A
visual_description: A greyscale vertical image of a large elephant walking, it's looking down at the viewer. There is a bright sky full of clouds in the background.

title: I Need a Nap
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 5
visual_description: A small panda bear is resting on the branches of a bare and thin tree. There are bright red fruits hanging from the branches. The bear stands on its left leg as the other rests on a branch, sloping it's body to the right. The background is a plain slate grey color.

title: Pick Up!
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall I
visual_description: A couple stands in the middle of a city street with many yellow window storefronts. There is a yellow beetle car parked beside the woman on the left. The woman has large cartoon eyes and wears a long green dress with pink boots and sweater. The man beside her wears blue jeans and a brown jacket. In the background there is a couple wlaking in the opposite direction.

title: Just Weird
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall I
visual_description: Eight large and long faces crowded around eachother. They all have bright pink and red slightly parted feminine lips. They have wide eyes looking up, and strong assymetrical cheekbones, with strong rounded chins. The backgorund and top of the painting is a light and dark pink with accented white and light pink lines.

title: Hell Hound
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 2
visual_description: A small pencil line drawing in the upper left corner of the page: the head of a dog like creature. It has a long snout and squarish head, with pointed ears that spike up to resemble flames. Below the drawing are the words, "Hell Hound."

title: 2# Drawings of a Card
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall B
visual_description: A drawing of butterflies and pink and red roses. There is a bundle of roses in the upper left corner that has three flowers, and a single large flower at the bottom right corner. In the center there is the biggest flower with six rose buds of different sizes. Above and below the flower there are two Monarch butterflies flying upwards. The edge of the pages is decorated with a delicate wavy line that resemebles the edge of a doile.

title: I Miss Outdoors
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall H
subject_tags: landscape; painting; animals; wildlife; nature; watercolor
visual_description: A landscape of a forest with a small waterfall, and a river with round rocks on the banks. There are skinny trees and green, orange, and red foliage, suggesting Autumn. Two large Mallad ducks are flying through the landscape at a close range to the left of the page.

title: Stop
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 5
visual_description: A vertical landscape of a Brown bear standing at a riverbank within a pine tree forest in Autumn, the sky is filled with clouds and there is a distant mountain on the horizon. The trees are reflected on the left of the waters surface. The bear is looking to the left with an open jaw, exposing teeth as if in defense. The riverbank is surrounded by patchy grass and medium sized grey stones.

title: SKAKE
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall A
visual_description: Four simplified figures standing beside eachother, dancing in roller skates. There are two women and two men. The women are wearing mini skirts, and have long dark hair, one is holding a red cup suggesting alcohol. Both men are wearing short sleevs and long pants. The man to the left wears a shirt that says, "Peace," and pants that on each leg say, "Love," and "Joy." They are in a yellow room with yellow brick wall, and yellow checkerboard flooring.

title: Mother & Child Reunion
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall H
visual_description: A safari landscape of a watering hole. There are three pairs of animals: to the left at the watering hole there is a large and smaller baby Rhinoceros. Across from them, there is a large and baby elephant, they have their trunks raised to drink water. In the grass in the background, there are two Zebras gazing toward the water.

title: Dogtown Atelier
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall E
visual_description: A vertical painting of a chaotic scene within a blue prison cell: There are two men interacting with dogs. There are eight dogs. One man is fighting for something from a dog's mouth, he is covered in paint, and a different dog is pulling at the bottom of his t-shirt. The other man is painting peacefully with one dog in his lap, and one at his feet wearing his hat. There are two dogs resting on the top of a bunk bed, one dripping green paint from the paws, another resting. On the bottom bunk there is a dog observing the stuggle between the man and two dogs. Finally there is a dog smiling with it's tongue out dripping in yellow paint at the botom left.

title: Next Up
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall E
subject_tags: Still life; painting; art making; confinement
visual_description: A dark workshop illuminated by a single yellow lamp. A man is painting at a bench, behind him there is a small wall that two men are standing at, they are wearing prison uniforms. Beside the door, there are tall lockers, and a man standing in the doorway next to a man sitting in a chair.

title: This is No Longer Me
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall G
visual_description: A square illustration of a person sitting on the porch steps of a house that is being grasped by two large hands, crushing the two front windows. The person sits with their hands on their head, the front door is open, revealing dark hallways of the interior. Over the right side of the house, there is an inscription written vertically that says, "Dear DJ, Don't worry, it's almost over!!"

title: Copper Penny Dream
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 2
visual_description: A black horizontal painting of overlapping and dripping paint lines. The paint strokes are a bronze copper color, and white. The colors are drizzled over a black background.

title: Without Resources
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall C

title: Beauty is Messy
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 3
visual_description: An orange and green spotchy background with accents of purple, red, and brown, There are four strong dark brown strokes that create a frame around the central subject: a black series of lines with darkly shaded closed shapes. The lines appear to flow from a central point in a shape that resmbles an abstracted rose.

title: And She'll Still Never Be Yours: Global Warming and Deregulation
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall F
subject_tags: Surrealist; paint; cosmic; fantasy; climate change
visual_description: A space landscape of four floating balloons and a bottlecap like floating object. There are two small yellow balloons, and one larger orange one, suggesting depth. The largest balloon is sideways, and resembles the shape of a balloon with the colors of Earth. A small person in a suit is riding the top of it, as if it were a parade float.

title: Syesthesia: A Wild Ride
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall C
visual_description: A man's face is twisted and is stretched into a long spiral shape that receeds into a circular path into the distance. The face has wide green eyes, and a mouth wide open esposing a ugula and long tongue. The top and bottom of the head blend into pink and purple lines that blend into rainbow colors. The background is a white and grey spiral.

title: In Death We See That in Life We Were Blind
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 5
visual_description: A split image of a woman: on the left a woman's face, and on the right a skeleton. The left the woman is alive with long dark hair but has white eyes. The skeleton has a human eye with golden iris, and the same long hair but white.

title: Our Worlds Tree: Parts 1, 2, 3
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall C
visual_description: Three horizontal drawings arranged above eachother vertically. The top drawing is the top of a tree with thick branches, no leaves, and curving sharp branches. The center drawing has two large trunks turning downward on each side of the main trunk. The main trunk has a large vertical eye in the center. The bottom panel is the bottom of the tree and the root system which grows out of a skeleton's eye sockets, over the Jaw and teeth.

title: Black. Off Pale Skies. . .
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 3
visual_description: A neck up portrait of a small Black child who gazes toward the right with a wide smile. They have short dark hair. The background is a purple sky with white clouds. On the child's head is a yellow ornate crown, and the same pattern is on each shoulder. The pattern resembles iron work, like a fence or gate.

title: Dream Catcher
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall G
subject_tags: Three dimensional; built work; natural material
visual_description: A dream catcher with seven brown circles in three rows: one on the left, five in the center surrounding a black ring, and one on the right. Eleven black feathers hang from the middle and bottom row of rings. Every ring except the one at the very top and center has small colorful beads within the circle.

title: Pride of Detroit
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 1

title: Here's Johnny
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall B
visual_description: A large portrait of a close up face of the character Jack Torrence from the film, The Shining. His face is facing the left, and his mouth is open exposing large teeth.

title: Small Motorcycle
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 4

title: Where Do We Go From Here?
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall C
visual_description: A purple and black space landscape with accents of yellow small stars. There is a large recntangular shape, the top is receeding backwards into space. The shape has a black edge, grey receeding rectangle or floor leading to a small black rectanglar door, and large white walls.

title: Light Psychosis
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall C
visual_description: A person sits on the floor of a cell surrounded by fantastical and colorful images arranged in a circle that all blend into eachother. Imagery surrounding the person includes: a melting clock, a beach paradise, a man and woman kissing, a spoon with heroin melting into a womans hair, human faces and hearts, In the background there is a large sand dune beside a body of water with the sun on the horizon.

title: Pooh Box
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall G
visual_description: A series of five boxes that get smaller in size from left to right. The boxes are decorated with Whinnie The Pooh, and have a color palette of yellow, red, and white. There are drawn on bows on each box.

title: Maternal Tree
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 4
subject_tags: Three dimensional; craft material; fabric; nature
visual_description: A small sculpture of a tree with a thick trunk, one large branch and two smaller ones. There are wines and string hanging from the tree that carry yellow and red roses. The tree is on a green platform.

title: The Crying Women
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 1
visual_description: A woman sits on an orange couch, her hand holding a phone and the other wiping away tears. There is a bag beside her on the couch.

title: Beautiful - Day or Night
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 6
visual_description: A portrait of a girl with short brown hair covering the left eye, she wears a purple hoodie and flower headband. The background is split: the left is yellow and has a sun with big triangular rays wearing sunglasses, the right has a blue night sky with a crescent moon wearing a night cap.

title: Under Pressure
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall B
visual_description: A central figure of a skinny woman in a red ballerina outfit is turned away twisting around a corner. There is a large grey wall, and black wall beside her framing her body.

title: Divine Wine
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall C
subject_tags: surrealist; drawing; colored pencil; still life
visual_description: A still life of a table and pale hand pouring a glass of water. There are mulitple reflective surfaces: glass, liquids. In the reflection of a champagne flute being tipped by a hand, there is a rainbow with two faces. The left of the drawing has more geometric abstractions of purple , blue, green, and yellow.

title: Holiday Greeting Cards
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 2
subject_tags: greeting cards; colored pencil; holidays; text
visual_description: three tall rectangle greeting cards; a snowman walking with a stick that says, "Merry chirstmas," a walking pumpkin wearing a witch hat, and a heart boreded card that says, "thinking of you."

title: Netcher-ef
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 1
visual_description: A drawing of Egyptian motifs and glyphs. There are two human like people kneeling with snake heads and bird wings. They point to a series of glyphs, Above that there is a crescent moon surrounding a star with the eye of Ra in the center.

title: Constitution Cemetery
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 2
visual_description: An illustration of two large gargoule like creatures resting on brick platforms of a wire gate that reads, "Consitution Cemetery," in yellow letters. The right creature is red and has a mashed leg of a police officer. Beneath it is a poster on the brick of a Black Lives Matter poster, with All written on top of the word Black. The left is a creature in police uniform wearing a cloth mask. The poster on the brick beneath it is of Uncle Sam, "I Want You," and he is wearing a face mask. The background is a cemetery with large plue sky with lightening bolts.

title: They Tried to Bury You But Your 2 Seed
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 1
visual_description: A painting of a tree split into two different environments, around the base of the tree is a round circle of dirt with text that says, "They buried you, but you're a seed." The left of the tree has purple leaves and a yellow background with more green and purple trees. The left is a large reflective body of water and large mountain.

title: Past
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall C
visual_description: A drawing of intracite stretched lattice of lines that resemble webs or flesh. The gaps between are shaded black, pink, or red. There are motifs of teeth, eyeballs, and skulls morphing into the drawing.

title: Lonely Storm and Sorrow
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall C
visual_description: A drawing of a woman with long flowing hair and dress gazes toward the ground. She stands in front of a large ornate circular clock. The background is a sky full of lightening bolrs. The drawing is framed by a broken or shattered mirror.

title: THE TRUTH???
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall I
visual_description: A portrait of a woman from the neck up with short purple hair and green gauged earrings. The face is split in half, with one side a skull that is melting red and green. The human side of the face has green veins surrounding the eye, and there is a mechanical object connected to her neck and head, with a small grey body and blue chest holding a small human face. There is dripping blood vertical text that says, "beware the system."

title: Masai Tribesmen in the Masai Mara
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall B
visual_description: Three floating African people wearing red tribal garments are hovering over the ground, looking up at the sky. There is a huge blue sky, and green open field.

title: Tough Times
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall G
visual_description: A square clock with the Detroit Lions logo painted on it, and gold numbers of the clock toward the left.

title: Celestial Mechanics
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 3

title: Symbiotic Lust
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall I
visual_description: A portrait of a womanin three parts: two close ups and a more erotic gore waitst up portrait. The two faces are half skeleton faces, and morph into electrical machine wires. The woman in the center has her arms raised, and her bare chest is ripped out exposing a rib cage and bright red heart bkeeding and morphing into the electrical machinery.

title: The Slashers
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 5
visual_description: A drawing of three classic horror movie characters: Michael Meyers, Chucky the doll, and Freddy Kreuger. They are holding instruments: a drumstick, keyboard, and microphone. Above them is a title, "The Slashers."

title: Looks Like Dinner
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 3
visual_description: A landscape of a lush plain with large brown rocks in the backgorund and a large plue sky. There are tall green grasses and small trees. There is a Turkey in the grasses to the right, and a Fox in an open patch of grass gazing toward the Turkey.

title: Skull with Wings and Rose (Promise)
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 4
visual_description: A drawing of a white skull that has large white angel wings pointed downward. Below it is a large red rose, and a blue banner. Beside the wings are two axes. In the background there is a rounded shape or purple, and large yellow background.

title: Tiger and Bea (Stranger than You)
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall H
visual_description: A traditional Chinese style drawing of a large tiger looking up at a large bee. There are sprouts of grass and big puffy spiral clouds in the background, There are Chinese characters written along the left and rights edges of the page.

title: Boy Hurt (Why)
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall G
visual_description: A drawing of a skinny boy wearing torn and bloodstained clothing sits against a brick wall hugging his knees. He is bruised and has a bloodshot eye. There is text above his head that says, "Nothing left to lose."

title: Tarsier
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall H
visual_description: A drawing of a small Tarsier marsupial resting on a thin branch surrounded by large green ferns and a blue sky. The tarsier is wearing an acorn hat, a cloak of leaves sewn together, and has a small bow and arrows behind it.

title: Indian Spirit
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall I
subject_tags: two dimensional; watercolor; colored pencil; skulls
visual_description: A large skull wearing a Native American style headdress of blue, green, and yellow feathers and leaves. The skull has two green lines drawn over the eyes down toward the chin. The background is green and has many small yellow and blue/green flaming skulls.

title: Olga's Flight of an Aeroplane (An Encomium to Olga Rozanova)
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall C
visual_description: An abstraction of square, recantgle, and triangular shapes in various colors: blues, purple, oramge, green, brown, yellow. There are larger blue and yellow rectangle shapes in the background, and smaller triangle and thick lines and semi circles in the foreground.

title: Hail (Salt Technique and Cellophane)
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall C
visual_description: A painting of color with texture: at the top of the page is a washed out white with patches of yellow coming through. Underneath is a large section of yellow that has a texture resembling krinkled paper. At the bottom is a dark green section with edges resembling paint splattering. The texture appears to have small dots of yellow within the green.

title: Ocean view
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall I
subject_tags: two dimensional; painting; colored pencil; recreation
visual_description: A painting of an underwater cave with many schools of small fish, three black and white spotted Sting-Rays, and two scuba divers swimming back up to the surface. The dark rocks of the cave contrast the bright blue opening of water in the center of the page.

title: Blue Sky
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 1
visual_description: A large yellow and black butterfly rests on a purple Hyacinth flower. There are smaller yellow flowers closer to the ground, and another purple Hyacinth leaning toward the left. There is a large blue sky that is 2/3 of page.

title: Path to Greatness
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 2
visual_description: A gresycale landscape of a tall mountain with a snowcapped peak. There are a few pine trees at the base of the mountain, near an open plain of grass.

title: Mr. No Body
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 2
visual_description: A cartoonish and short skeleton is walking beside a brick wall with tall grass. It's arm is raised as if to ask a question. There is a thought bubble above the skull saying, "Where's that body shop?"

title: That's Michigan
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall D
visual_description: A vertical landscape painting of a red and dark sunset. There is a long pier and tall lighthouse in front of the sunset. The sun has lined up perfectly nehind the top of the lighthouse, there is a bright yellow glow. On the water you can see the reflection of the sunset and lighthouse, there are four sihlouettes of people watching the sunset.

title: A Monarch to Pare - Or not - to Spare?
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 4
visual_description: A Black woman rests high up on a tree branch, with her back resting against the trunk. She has large Monarch butterfly wings, and is wearing a long blue shirt and jeans with knee-high brown laced up sneakers. She raises a hand to her face, it has a small caterpillar on it. Behind her is lush green foliage of a forest.

title: Sunset in Nova Scotia
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 1
visual_description: A photorealistic landscape painting of a large body of water with waves crashing against a shore of large grey rocks on the right of the page. The orange and yellow sunset is reflected in the blue and purple water. In the sky above the sunset there are large and thick purple clouds.

title: Tyson's Sword
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall I
visual_description: A vertical painting of a woman knight riding a large dark hose wearing a purple cape. The woman and horse are facing the right, down a Grecco-Roman architecture corridor. The woman is facing the viewer, long dark hair blowing in the wind and carrying a large gold and silver sword. Red leaves scatter the stone ground and arches.

title: Twisted in Color
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall C

title: Zinnia
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall D
visual_description: A series of tiles painted to collectively illustrate a large open green field and blue sky with white puffy clouds. In the grasses to the left is a large pink Zinnia flower.

title: Cause & Effect
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall I
visual_description: A large lobster like monster stands vertically with it's legs and claws open around an unsuspecting man who is wearing a clear helment and grey suit, holding a yellow and red comic like gun. He holds in his other hand a round pink egg, he apperas to be standing on a large pile of eggs that are assumed to belong to the lobster creature behind him.

title: This is why kids are afraid of clowns
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 2
visual_description: A upwards perspective close up of two people in clown costumes gazing downward. The left clown is in white face paint with two orange dots on his cheeks, and a orange sequins suit jacket. He has sharp and distinct features. The clown to the right has bright red fuzzy straight hair to the shoulder, and has large arched eyebrows, bright red nose and outlined lips. His features are soft and plump, he is wearing a large purple bowtie and black and white suit.

title: Diamond in the Rough
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 2
visual_description: A large white seabird rests on a wooden pier's railing. In the backgorund is a large blue body of water with many waves, and a bright yellow sun barely rising over the horizon.

title: BEACHED
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall I
visual_description: A sandy beach shore with blue waves washing up. There is a green and pink turtle washed up on the shore, lying on it's stomach beside a collection of rocks and stones.

title: Warrior's Promise
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall I
visual_description: A horizontal drawing of a blue Samurai standing outside at night, the moon is huge and illuminated behind him. The night sky is filled with white sparkling stars. On each side of the Samurai are two trees, the one on the right has red leaves that are being swept upwards to the left.

title: The Girl with a Pearl Earring (Vermeer Reproduction)
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall E
visual_description: A recreation of the famous Vermeer painting, Girl With A Pearl Earring. Against a black background there is a woman wearing a blue headband, and yellow headscarf that falls beside her shoulder. She stands toward the left, gazing over her left shoulder. She has pale skin and golden brown eyes. From her ear dangles a shiney and round pearl earring.

title: Despair
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall G
visual_description: A dramatic painting of a woman falling, her prison uniform shirt being ripped by a pair of handcuffed arms. Her arms are outstretched, one is being pulled down by another cuffed hand. The other is reaching toward the sky, a single shackle hanging from her wrist. There is a pair of arms reaching down from the sky, there are wounds in the center of the palms. In the background there is a tall barbed wire fence and a strike of lightning striking a white guard tower in a stormy and grey sky.

title: Beauty Box
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 4

title: Red Wings
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall H
visual_description: A red and white textile made of yarn, it has a pattern resembling the Red Wings Hockey team.

title: Motorcycle, Red, Black, Silver
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 4
subject_tags: three dimensional; craft materials; vehicles; built work
visual_description: A small model of a motercyle with large silver handles a red body and black seat.

title: The Sower
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 3
visual_description: A landscape of a farm with green and yellow fields beside a wide dirt path leading to a large brown barn. Beside the barn are three large white and blue silos, and a smaller brown building. In the distance are large rolling hills and red trees.

title: Adam's Light
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall F
visual_description: A realistic painting of a standard clear lightbulb resting on a white surface.

title: Through the Valley in the Shadow of Covid
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall F
visual_description: A man holds a young girls hand as they walk on a brown path that has large blue and red circles representing COVID-19 on each side of the path. The sky is a dark blue with a yellow sunset.

title: Absurd Inhumanities
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall F
visual_description: In a large blue room with yellow horizontal panel of windows, there are people divided by a sheet of glass. One is in a prison uniform, the other is a woman and someone else. They touch their hands to each side of the glass, wearing COVID masks. There is a sign on the back wall that ways "Must wear mask! Fully Vacinated! Negative test! Stay behind glass!!!"

title: The Crafty Witch
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 1
visual_description: A drawing of a woman laying sideways partially sitting up. Leaning on the left arm, her hand is holding a skull. She has long red hair and a large black which hat. She wears a white tight dress that exposes parts of her skin through the garment.

title: Turmoil
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 1
visual_description: A large turqoise colored swirl with white streaks. The painting has a central point to the left where all the lines seam to be pulling toward.

title: Original Guard Dog
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 1

title: Scottish Thistle
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 5

title: Arresting Jesus
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall E
visual_description: A portrait black and silver of Jesus, wearing handcuffs. His halo has three religious symbols.

title: Last Supper
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall I
visual_description: A black and silver etched drawing of the famous Last Supper painting.

title: Michigan Mud Ape
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 4

title: Dream big
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 4
visual_description: A oblong tall circle like shaped dream catcher, two rocks hang in the center, and three from the bottom of the wrapped circle. There are two grey feathers hanging from it as well.

title: Vacation
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall E
visual_description: A drawing in the shape of a Maple leaf: A rocky waterfall with bright blue then yellow waters. Grasses are between layers of rocks, and at the top of the small waterfall there are tall pine trees.

title: The Last Walk
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 1
visual_description: A black background with a few yellow stars, indicating space. There is a large yellow and green beam moving diagonally across the painting. There are three dancers wearing red dresses, and one boy in a blue coat walking away from the dancers, toward the right.

title: DANCE
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 2
visual_description: A pair of pink legs wearing purple ballerina shoes points one foot down and the other out. Behind the pair of legs, there are large curvy letters in different colors spelling, "DANCE," the D and A letters are above the others. In the pink background there are four small sihlouettes of dancers.

title: Layla and Mason
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall B
visual_description: A young white boy and girl sit beside eachother on the roof of a red car, their feet dangling into the sun roof. The boy has short blonde hair, and is wearing a white t shirt and shorts, with blue sandals. He is holding something in his lap. The girl beside him has long brown hair, rosy red cheeks, and is wearing a purple dress with white sandals, she is slightly smaller than the boy. In the background there is a highway with many cars, and a bright blue sky.

title: Nikita, Layla and Mason
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall B
visual_description: A family portrait of a woman between two young children: a boy with longish blonde hair wearing a formal white shirt and black vest, and a young girl with dark hair wearing a tiara, and a denim jacket. She holds in her two hands a purple and pink toy. The woman between them has long dark hair with bangs swept to the left. She has bright pink lips, and blue eyes. In the background there are large red balloons.

title: Halloween's Collective Identity
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 1
visual_description: An almost nude woman from the chest up is wearing Dia De Los Muertos, Day of the Dead, face makeup with lines on her lips and large red circles around the eyes. She has a bright red rose in her wavy short dark hair to the left. From her neck dangles a large diamond necklace. Her breasts are covered. Above the drawing is text written, "How happy do you want your Halloween? Peek-a-boo!"

title: No One Knows the Future
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 1
visual_description: A system of entwined wires, or stems wind around eachother from two seperate directions to create a central column that supports a large white sphere with eleven question marks drawn on it's surface.

title: Night Flight
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 2
visual_description: A Black fairy with grey eyes and short dark hair is holding a butterfly on one hand in the night. She is wearing a blue strapless short dress. Her wings are large and intricate purple, orange, and green. Behind her is the full illuminate moon surrounded by grey clouds and the starry sky.

title: Visions
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall F
visual_description: A point of view painting of the foot of a hospital bed, wall, and sliver of a window to the right that exposes some building. There are large diamond like shapes near the top left and middle of the painting. The blue shapes have long lines extending from each of the points. They obscure what is behind them on the wall: a black telvsion and white board with green marker written on it.

title: Tranquility
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 2

title: Sico Clown
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 1
visual_description: A full body drawing of a clown wearing a white outfit with black polka dots and red puffy cuffs on the shirt and pant legs. The clowns hair is pointy and red, and it has yellow eyes . It's left arm is unsually long and raised as if knocking on a door.

title: Us Americans
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 2
visual_description: A painting of a large United States flag, blowing to the right. In the bright blue background there are small green military vehicles. There is a series of large orange block text that reads, " These colors do not run, they reload."

title: Misunderstood
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall A
visual_description: A paiting of a Black man and a small brown and white pitbull dog resting between the man's legs. The man has his head hung low, we only see the top of the black hat he is wearing. He is sitting on a boombox. He has large muscular arms exposed through a white tank top, he is also wearing blue jeans. Behind him is a brick wall.

title: Content
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall B
visual_description: A painting of an old Black man resting against a wall. He has one legs crossed over the other. He is wearing a large zip up tan sweater, and blue jeans. His hand rests on the handle of a backet beside him. His eyes are cast down, and there are strong shadows and light.

title: Finding the Light
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall A
visual_description: A landscape pencil drawing of a cobblestone facade building and small brick plaza. The building has two arches that contain to bells, and at the top of the building there is one large arch with one larger bell, and a cross at the apex of the building. There are light beams streaming through the top bell and cross that illuminate the entire sky. Beside the church is a thin but large tree, larger of the same size as the church itself. There are bushes and in the background smaller arches belonging to the rest of the building.

title: Winter's Retreat
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall D
visual_description: A vertical greyscale drawing of a large shipwrecked boat on a beach. Three seagulls rest on the boat. In the background there is the figure of a man in the water fishing.

title: How Should we Use Our Powers to Change the World?
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall C
visual_description: A drawing of an apocalyptic type scene with distant buildings surrounded by smoke, and ash falling from the sky. There is a large hole in the ground, and in the center a single pillar. On the rock pillar is a small person with long hair, wearing a plague doctor mask. The person is looking down into their hands that are holding a small dark object.

title: A Crying Heart
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall G
visual_description: A large red cartoon heart is in the center of the painting, surrounding it are two blue birds, a yellow sky with magenta clouds, and a purple sea. From the heart there are spikes, and tears flowing from a single green photorealistic eye in the center of the heart.

title: An Artist is Born
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall B
visual_description: A small boy painted in greyscale is holding a paintbrush, he is surrounded by an explosion of colors behind him: pink, yellow, orange, and purples. The paintbrush from his left hand is dripping blue paint that drips down into the word, "Love."

title: Home Sweet Home
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall E
visual_description: A vertical still life painting. On a yellow table there is a tell round ceramic vessel. It has a series of straight and wavy lines painted on it near the top. At the foot of the vessel is a basket of lemons, and two lemons on the table. The basket is resting on white textiles folded over and draping off the table. The wall behind the table is brown and cracked,there is a framed picture that has white letters reading, "Home sweet home."

title: An American Symbol
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall H
visual_description: A drawing of a Blad Eagle flying close to the ground, it's wings spread up and back, and talons outstretched. It's close to two large grey rocks that reside in an open green field with more rocks in the background. There is a large empty blue sky. The painting is framed by a brown geometric painted border.

title: A Peaceful Valley
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall D
visual_description: A serene painting of a dirt path leading to a stone bridge over a creek and to a small stone cottage. Surrounding the path and house are large yellow birch trees, red maple trees, and tall green pine trees. In the far distance there is a snpw capped mountain and yellow sky.

title: Mountain Cabin
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 1
visual_description: A serene painting of a thin dirt path leading to the steps of a stone church with tall blue steeple. To the left there is a stone bridge over grey water surronded by flowers, ivy, and blue and purple bushes. The grey river leads to the background that has large stones and coloful Autumn trees at it's edge. The river becomes a thin line descending from a tall mountain surrounded by clouds and birds in the distance.

title: Mountain Church
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall D
visual_description: a whimsical landscape painting of a cabin with a small farm near a body of water, with a large mountain range at the shore. There are tall pine trees, and grey stones around the water and cabin. The cabin's lights illuminate a porch and two cows in a pen beside the building. There is a small campfire along the water's shore in front of the house.

title: Just a Thought
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall H

title: Contemplation
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 1

title: A Force
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 4

title: Easter Lilies
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall H
visual_description: A drawing of a bush of tall plants with woody stems and green leaves are holding up two bright red Northern Cardinals. One Cardinal leans forward pointing it's beak toward a small green caterpillar resting on a stem.

title: Swallowtail Butterfly
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall H
visual_description: A large yellow butterfly with black and purple edges and small stripes rests on a bunch of pointy green leaves. The green leaves have small purple flowers growing from the center of the stems.

title: Autumn Cardinals
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 4
visual_description: Two large white Lillies with bright green stems, and two more that have not yet opened up. The background is a soft and blended blue with closed lily pod like shapes of green blended into the soft light blue.

title: Butterfly
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall C
visual_description: A simple line drawing on white paper. The line in black ink starts at the bottom left and surves upwards and out to create the shape of a butterfly wing, then the line moves to the right down, up, and down once more to create the shape of the body and another wing. There are two dots over the body indivating eyes or antennae.

title: Horse
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 1

title: Beautiful Music
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 1

title: Life, Death and Smell the Roses
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 6
visual_description: A pencil drawing of a skull, the forehead of the skull is large and contains a circular clock with large ornate hands that extend past the edge of the skull. In the center of that clock with roman numerals, there is a single dark eye.

title: Backwards in Time
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 1

title: Falling Down Locked Up
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall F
visual_description: An intense drawing of a point of view of a person with their hands extended from darkness. The hands reached out are shackled and have strong veins. The fingers and palms are illuminated by a bright yellow light that is shining in thick bright beams through a cell window, down a grey cracked brick wall. Through the cell window you see a bright yellow space, and an orange winged creature flying downwards.

title: Horse
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall H

title: Pokeball
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 1
subject_tags: two dimensional; watercolor; fantasy; science fiction
visual_description: A watercolor painting of a Poké Ball, from the Pokemon series: A small sphere with a red top and white bottom, in the center a black band that has a circle in the center of it. There are colors and speckles of red and purple near the top of the sphere.

title: Even in the Dark, There's Beauty
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall A
visual_description: A portrait of a Black woman with her bare head tilted back, exposing the right side of her face. Her hand rests on her neck below her chin. She is facing a bright yellow light toward the left, and the right side of her is in a blue darkness.

title: Aren't Dogs Sweet?!?
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall E

title: Holding Emotions
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall G
visual_description: A vertical pencil drawing of a man's head resting in his palm. The man is coming from the left of the drawing. He has long straight dark hair that covers part of his hand and face. His hand is covering his nose, he closes his eyes. The background has a halo of light around the man that blends into grey toward the edges of the drawing.

title: Melting Sadness
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Zone 2
visual_description: A vertical portrait of a woman with her head tilted toward the sky. Her hair is a short, straight, and a purple color. As it falls to her shoulder, her shoulder blends into the background. Her blue eyes have a single tear flowing down her face. The background is a purple and blue blended vertically, that turns into a yellow and green toward the bottom of the page.

title: the Color of Drawing
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall B
visual_description: a watercolor painting of a man wearing a blue shirt playing two blue small drums.

title: Not Again
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall B
visual_description: An ink portrait drawing of a person from the neck up: their head is tilted to the right, and resting in the palm of their hand. The lines of ink create dark shades that create volume on the face, and lines that create texture. Only the left side of the face is visible, the rest is hidden within the palm of the hand, and hair swept into the face.

title: I Need Someone to Hug!
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall A
visual_description: A painting of a woman standing on a green round path of grass. She is wearing a long red dress, her arms crossed over one another. Her head is tilted slightly to the left, she has short dark hair and a blank expression. The sky behind her is a pale blue.

title: When the Wizard Walks By
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall E
visual_description: A vertical black and white drawing of a tall and crumbling castle. Standing beside a large, twisted bare tree, is a wizard carrying a large staff and wearing a large pointy hat.

title: Serenity
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 4

title: The Face of God
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 4
visual_description: A drawing of a section of a man's face, abstrcated by colors, symbols, and negative space. The background is a cosmic scene of bright small colorful lines that create small swirls, planets, and stars. The man's face has a brown beard that has yellow astrological symbols painted on it. One eye is a blue swirl of color, and the other is a bright yellow. Where the forhead would be, is a flaming symbol of Yin and Yang.

title: Synergistic
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall C
visual_description: A psychedelic drawing of a body of water and rainbow sky. The drawing is done in a similar style to the band, The Grateful Dead. There are green and orange bears surfing the blue water on flowers. Beside them is a skull wearing a red bandana with a blue bolt in the center. In the far distance there is a colofrul orb that emits large beams of light, within the honeycomb rainbow sky. There is a white cloud with a white bear on it. At the bottom of the page there are words written in rainbow block letters, "He had to die."

title: Steal Your Heart
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 4
visual_description: A vertical drawing of an arrangement of three skulls and roses surrounding them. The background are grey shaded rings. There are two smaller skulls with a larger one above them, the larger one has a large black tear on the forehead that reveals an opening of space, stars, and a red and blue planet. There is text at the bottom in white curvy letters that says, "Steal your face." The drawing refrences the musical group The Grateful Dead.

title: Thanks for the Service
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 2
visual_description: A large ship on a blue ocean. The ship has orange fluid leaking from the deck, and has a United States flag hanging from a control center. In the blue sky there is a large United States flag on the left, and a jet plane with orange tipped wings flying on the right.

title: Beauty
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 4
visual_description: A Black woman poses by sitting with her arm laying across her pointed knee, she looks off to the right. Her hand rests on the left sife of her face. She has big brown eyes and pink lips. Her forhead is cut off by large pink cursive letters with a yellow outline that say, "Beauty"

title: The Lone Sax
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 4
visual_description: A greyscale and realistic drawing of a saxophone, slightly tilted to the right with it's mouthpiece facing the left.

title: The Sax Man
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Bin 5
visual_description: A greyscale drawing of a man from the waist up playing a saxophone. The man has short dark hair combed back, and a thin mustache. He is wearing a suit and his eyes are closed as her plays the instrument.

title: Blessed Art Thou
exhibition_source: 26th Annual Exhibition of Art by Michigan Prisoners; Wall F
visual_description: A landscape image of a religious scene: four people kneeling at God's feet. God's arms are raised, and has a gold halo around the head.
